answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. An identity earns only when its terrace recurs, its yarrow survives audit, and a grove from an unlinked peer confirms it.
